title: Towards Comprehensible Recommendation with Large Language Model Fine-tuning
abstract: arXiv:2508.07595v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recommender systems have become increasingly ubiquitous in daily life. While traditional recommendation approaches primarily rely on ID-based representations or item-side content features, they often fall short in capturing the underlying semantics aligned with user preferences (e.g., recommendation reasons for items), leading to a semantic-collaborative gap. Recently emerged LLM-based feature extraction approaches also face a key challenge: how to ensure that LLMs possess recommendation-aligned reasoning capabilities and can generate accurate, personalized reasons to mitigate the semantic-collaborative gap. To address these issues, we propose a novel Content Understanding from a Collaborative Perspective framework (CURec), which generates collaborative-aligned content features for more comprehensive recommendations. translated_title: 基于大语言模型微调的可理解推荐
translated_abstract: 推荐系统在日常生活中已变得越来越普遍。传统推荐方法主要依赖于基于ID的表示或物品侧的内容特征，往往无法捕获与用户偏好相一致的底层语义（例如物品的推荐理由），从而导致“语义-协同鸿沟”。近期出现的基于大语言模型（LLM）的特征提取方法也面临一个关键挑战：如何确保大语言模型具备与推荐对齐的推理能力，并能生成准确、个性化的推荐理由以弥合这一鸿沟。为解决这些问题，我们提出了一种新颖的协同视角内容理解框架，该框架能够生成与协同信号对齐的内容特征，从而实现更全面的推荐。CURec首先通过后训练以推荐目标对大语言模型进行适配，使其具备指令遵循能力……
tldr: 提出CURec框架，通过以推荐目标对大语言模型进行后训练微调，生成与协同信号对齐的内容特征，弥合语义-协同鸿沟，实现更全面、可理解的个性化推荐。
en_tdlr: Proposes CURec, a framework that fine-tunes LLMs with recommendation objectives to generate collaborative-aligned content features, bridging the semantic-collaborative gap for more comprehensible recommendations.
